tools.name: list_geo_themes
tools.description:
Free. Theme keys, labels, linked assets, coverage (qualifying markets,
    whale USD held, sufficient flag), method version and field notes for
    get_geo_themes. Use it to decide whether a paid call is worth making.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description:
Free. QSIG's published validation policy: which products are live,
    what validation each carries, and which models were KILLED for failing
    the pre-registered criterion (walk-forward AUC < 0.55), with reasons.

    Use this to judge whether the paid data is worth buying.

tools.name: get_method
tools.description:
Free. What QSIG sells - the georisk score and the geopolitical theme
    board (get_geo_themes) - what each does and does not claim, pricing,
    and the payment network.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_method" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Free. How the georisk score is built, what it does and does not claim,
    pricing, and the payment network." → after: "Free. What QSIG sells - the georisk score and the geopolitical theme
    board (get_geo_themes) - what each does and does not claim, pricing,
    and the payment network."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
